'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male [[NPC]] student who can be found near the [[Resonance Nexus|Solar Lens Array]] in [[Startorch Academy]] at night, being scolded by a [[TARD-E Unit]]. 

==Location==

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''TARD-E Unit:''' Your paper submission is late by exactly 2 Lahai-Roi days, 7 hours, 5 minutes, and 36 seconds.
:'''Jingxing:''' Arrrrrggghhh! STOP IT, PLEASE! I'll write it now!
:'''TARD-E Unit:''' You once claimed a Fluffguin stole your paper, causing the delay.
:'''TARD-E Unit:''' That's a violation of Research Integrity Protocols. It also disappoints this TARD-E Unit.
:'''Jingxing:''' Seriously…? You sound just like my mom right now.
:'''TARD-E Unit:''' Acknowledged. Activating "parental nagging module."
:'''TARD-E Unit:''' Why can't you stop playing for one second and focus on finishing your homework?!
:'''TARD-E Unit:''' Look at your classmate [[Elios]]! Now that's a model student!
:'''Jingxing:''' ...FINE! I'll get it done, okay?!
{{Dialogue End}}
